definition.proposition: In the assembled ternary model A2s, keeping either the mixer projections (A3x) or the FFN (A3y) in full precision recovers about 5% clean80 bpc each (A3x -5.0%, A3y -5.2%), so the cost of ternary is split about evenly between mixers and FFN, and the two recoveries sum to about the full-precision gap (+9.5%, C204's A2s vs A2f).

scope.precision: ternary BitNet b1.58 via STE + int8 activations where ternary; bf16 elsewhere

definition.refutation_criteria: REFUTED if a fresh-seed replication's paired 95% CI for either arm includes 0, or if the two effects differ by more than 2 points

qual: 3 fresh seeds, registered, Holm family of 4
reason: A3x - A2s = -5.02% [-6.11, -3.92], per seed -5.24 / -4.51 / -5.31; A3y - A2s = -5.16% [-5.31, -5.01], per seed -5.15 / -5.22 / -5.11 (seeds 5-7, df 2). Holm steps 3 and 1 reject. Registered Q2 predicted the cost sits more in the mixers (A3x -5%, A3y -3%): both in range, but the predicted asymmetry did not appear.

verified_at.basis: HEAD of the checkout when the event was recorded

limitations.text: Measured inside the A2s recipe at one model size and horizon; the split may differ at scale or with the MoE core (A3mx keeps the FFN ternary as MoE experts and the mixers in full precision).
